correctness.rationale: Injective coordinate projection proves the point-count bound; equality gives all projected grid points. Values at zero and unit vectors force integral affine coefficients. Width at most k forces each nonconstant coordinate to be a single signed projected variable, with intercept zero or k. The intrinsic signed-block decomposition is unique modulo one global sign per block. Standard set partitions and the exponential formula yield the count and finite-difference polynomial. A separate exact rational affine-span checker found the predicted numbers for ten exhaustively enumerable grid settings and confirmed the two formula forms in 231 parameter cases; all-dimensional correctness rests on the direct proof.

value.rationale: A direct exact calculation across all ranks, dimensions, and positive dilations of the maximal-section counting invariant for integral cubes provides an explicitly solved natural family of the conjectural eventual quasi-polynomial problem, including exact degree, leading coefficient, complete optimizer structure and an exponential generating function. These aspects are not implied by merely knowing the maximal lattice-point count; the problem is not an arbitrary finite slice.
